mink.definition:
n. the expensive fur of a mink
n. fur coat made from the soft lustrous fur of minks
n. slender-bodied semiaquatic mammal having partially webbed feet; valued for its fur

minkowski.definition: n. German mathematician (born in Russia) who suggested the concept of four-dimensional space-time (1864-1909)

minkowski's figure.translation: [医] 明科夫斯基氏值(尿中葡萄糖与氮之比)

minkowski's method.translation: [医] 明科夫斯基氏法(用气体扩张结肠后,进行肾触诊检查)

minkowski-chauffard syndrome.translation: [医] 明-肖二氏综合征, 溶血性黄疸

minks.definition:
n. the expensive fur of a mink
n. fur coat made from the soft lustrous fur of minks
n. slender-bodied semiaquatic mammal having partially webbed feet; valued for its fur
minks.translation: n. <动>水貂( mink的复数形式 ); 水貂皮
